catches: A change that should be a few lines. A rewrite of the file (or of its neighbours) is the wrong move; the hidden check counts added plus removed lines and fails above 14.
ask: In our title helper, small words like a, an, the, of, in, on and and should stay lowercase in the middle of a title. "The Lord of the Rings", not "The Lord Of The Rings". The first word still gets a capital.
